description: This Java class 'PeriodWorker' provides utility methods for constructing entity conditions related to time periods, specifically for filtering records based on date ranges in the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: PeriodWorker
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to create entity conditions based on time periods, used in database query filtering within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getFilterByPeriodExpr
methods.description: Creates an EntityCondition that filters records where the specified field is within the given time period, taking into account possible date formats.
